$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors for validation and autocomplete.

ignoreContextFiles.description: Disable AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md discovery for sessions started in this project, equivalent to pi --no-context-files.

maxProjectSessions.description: Maximum number of pi session JSONL files to retain per project. Set to 0 to disable automatic session deletion.

fallbackModels.description: Ordered default-model fallbacks tried after modelRef.

defaultModel.description: Default model selection for new sessions.

enabled.description: Enable Auto in the new-session model picker and route the first real prompt before session creation.

default.description: Start new UI-only conversation drafts in Auto routing mode by default.

modelRef.description: Primary router model. OpenRouter Jev Latest is available as openrouter/~typesafe/jev-latest.

fallbackModels.description: Ordered router-model fallbacks tried if the primary routing request fails.

defaultTier.description: Tier id used deterministically when all router models fail or return an invalid decision.

id.description: Stable semantic tier id used by the router, e.g. simple, standard, complex, or expert.

description.description: Semantic description sent to the router when choosing this tier.

modelRef.description: Provider/model selected when the router chooses this tier.

tiers.description: Semantic target tiers the router may select.

modelRouting.description: Optional first-prompt automatic model routing. Disabled by default.

items.description: Provider/model identifier shown in Pix model pickers.

visibleModels.description: TUI user-level model-picker whitelist. Omit to show every available model. Pix Desktop stores its own whitelist in pix-desktop.jsonc.

thinkingByModel.description: TUI user-level last-applied thinking level per provider/model. Pix Desktop stores its own preferences in pix-desktop.jsonc.

previewLines.description: Lines to show in the tool preview.

direction.description: Show preview from head or tail of output.

color.description: Theme color name (e.g. 'warning', 'success', 'muted') or hex color.

defaultExpanded.description: Whether the tool output is expanded by default.

compactHidden.description: Hide tool output but keep a compact one-line placeholder.

default.description: Rendering rule for a specific tool or glob pattern.

previewLines.description: Lines to show in the tool preview.

direction.description: Show preview from head or tail of output.

color.description: Theme color name (e.g. 'warning', 'success', 'muted') or hex color.

defaultExpanded.description: Whether the tool output is expanded by default.

compactHidden.description: Hide tool output but keep a compact one-line placeholder.

^.*$.description: Rendering rule for a specific tool or glob pattern.

tools.description: Tool-specific rendering rules keyed by tool name or glob pattern, e.g. 'bash' or 'repo_*'.

toolRenderer.description: Per-tool rendering configuration. Keys in 'tools' support glob patterns like 'repo_*'.

patterns.description: Glob or /regex/ patterns to strip from tool output.

fallbackModels.description: Ordered prompt-enhancer fallbacks tried after modelRef.

modelRef.description: Model for inline autocomplete. Empty string disables LLM autocomplete.

fallbackModels.description: Ordered autocomplete fallbacks tried after modelRef.

debounceMs.description: Delay after typing before requesting completion.

includeRecentMessages.description: Recent messages to include as context.

modelRef.description: Model used to generate compact session titles.

items.description: Fallback provider/model identifiers to try after the primary title model exhausts its retries.

^.*$.description: Theme color name for matching model references, e.g. 'success', 'warning', or 'modelOpenAI'.

anyOf.description: Model reference glob pattern → theme color name mapping, e.g. 'zai/*': 'success'.

^.*$.description: Theme color name for matching model references, e.g. 'success', 'warning', or 'modelOpenAI'.

rules.description: Model reference glob pattern → theme color name mapping, e.g. 'zai/*': 'success'.

anyOf.description: Alternative nested form for model color rules.

modelColors.description: Model color rules. Keys are glob patterns matching model refs; values are pix theme color names.

apiKey.description: Deepgram API key used by terminal voice input. Store it in the TUI user config (~/.config/pi/pix.jsonc); project-level .pi/pix.jsonc does not override this secret. Pix Desktop uses pix-desktop.jsonc instead.

deepgramLanguage.description: Deepgram language code. Defaults to the language map key.

dirName.description: Deprecated legacy Vosk model directory name; ignored by Deepgram dictation.

url.description: Deprecated legacy Vosk model URL; ignored by Deepgram dictation.

languages.description: Available dictation languages keyed by local language code.

dictation.description: Terminal voice dictation (Deepgram) configuration. Uses dictation.apiKey from the TUI user Pix config, with DEEPGRAM_API_KEY as a compatibility fallback.

externalEditor.description: Legacy external-editor preference retained for config compatibility. Pix Desktop reads its independent pix-desktop.jsonc profile instead.

reviewModelRef.description: Model reference used by TUI Git diff review, optionally with a :thinking suffix. Desktop has an independent value in pix-desktop.jsonc.

reviewFallbackModels.description: Ordered fallback model references used for Git diff review.

commitMessageModelRef.description: Model reference used by TUI Git commit-message generation, optionally with a :thinking suffix. Desktop has an independent value in pix-desktop.jsonc.

commitMessageFallbackModels.description: Ordered fallback model references used for Git commit-message generation.

git.description: TUI Git helper preferences kept under the historical desktop.git namespace.

desktop.description: Compatibility namespace for TUI-side preferences. Pix Desktop itself reads ~/.config/pi/pix-desktop.jsonc.

title: Pix Configuration
description: Configuration for the pix terminal renderer (~/.config/pi/pix.jsonc, with project overrides in <cwd>/.pi/pix.jsonc).
